title: The Secrets of the Mucosa
subtitle: Sami & Mina are counting on you
synopsis:
Welcome, Doctor! 🔬🦷

Sami is a hurried dentist: 'A white lesion? It's leukoplakia, we need to biopsy!' Mina, an expert in oral medicine, corrects him: 'Not so fast, Sami! Oral medicine is much more than just biopsies.'

Between a striated white lesion, a suspicious erythroplakia, a reticular lichen planus, or pemphigus vulgaris, oral medicine is a true art.

A misdiagnosis, an incorrectly indicated biopsy, and the patient undergoes unnecessary treatments. A rigorous observation, a methodical approach, and the patient is correctly managed.

The diagnosis of oral pathologies, patient health, and cancer prevention rest on YOUR shoulders.

chapters.intermediaire1: Sami and Mina master diagnosis: white and red lesions, differential diagnosis, biopsy, management.
chapters.intermediaire2: Sami and Mina tackle complex pathologies: autoimmune diseases, orofacial pain, syndromes, emergencies.

chapters.expert2: After years of practice, Sami and Mina leave a legacy of skills in oral medicine. Oral medicine is the art of reading the mucosa.
